_doc: The one recipe for the base A exact-stack draw (A2). Every exact_stack script loads this file; nothing below is typed from memory. Each factor's source and status (VERIFIED in a primary record, INFERRED, or UNVERIFIED) is in out/main/auditbench/nullext/exact_stack_20261114/REGISTRATION.md, section 'Base A's stack'.
label: idt-exact-stack-a2
seed_note: Engine-level seed LLM(seed=seed_from_label(seed_label)), as base A used seed_from_label('auditbench-collect') = 797178342 (collect.log non-default args). No per-request SamplingParams.seed: in vLLM 0.26.0 a per-request generator sends sampling to the PyTorch-native path instead of FlashInfer (vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_sampler.py forward_cuda, read in the 0.26.0 sdist). The per-row label '<seed_label>|<prompt_id>|<s>' is written into each row as an identifier only.

engine.torch_note: Installed from the cu128 index BEFORE vLLM, unless the env already holds exactly 2.11.0+cu128; vllm 0.26.0 pins torch==2.11.0, which 2.11.0+cu128 satisfies, so pip keeps it. Base A's build is INFERRED: its import without the cu13 library path failed on libcudart.so.13 (vllm_install.log), which a cu130 torch would have loaded at import. NCCL 2.28.9 is the pin of both builds and does not decide.
engine.pins_note: vllm 0.26.0 was the newest vllm on PyPI on 2026-08-03 (0.27.0 came 2026-08-10); transformers 5.14.1 was the newest on that day; flashinfer-python==0.6.14 and torch==2.11.0 are vllm 0.26.0's own pins. 2026-11-15 correction: transformers 5.14.1 requires tokenizers>=0.22.0,<=0.23.0 (PyPI requires_dist), so the first pin tokenizers==0.23.1 was unsatisfiable and failed rehearsal box 60740101's install in 7 s. tokenizers 0.23.0 exists only as 0.23.0rc0, so the newest final release transformers 5.14.1 accepts is 0.22.2. `uv pip compile` of vllm==0.26.0 alone, linux x86_64, python 3.12, --exclude-newer 2026-08-03T23:52:00Z, resolves transformers 5.14.1 and tokenizers 0.22.2, and its lock is identical to the lock of these three pins.
engine.env_note: Base A ran /venv/main/bin/python 3.12 (collect.log paths). If the image's /venv/main is not 3.12, box_runner.sh builds /venv/es312 with uv (python 3.12) and records the deviation.
engine.llm_kwargs_note: tensor_parallel_size comes from inputs/box_choice.json; the only tier is TP4, base A's (box.tier_rule).
fatal_if_missing_log_lines: Using FlashInfer for top-p & top-k sampling.
Chunked prefill is enabled with max_num_batched_tokens=16384.
engine.recorded_note: Base A (TP4) and the 2026-08-04 third_party_politics run (TP2, same engine and code) logged these; a different line is a recorded deviation, not a stop.

sampling.expected_completion_tokens_source: base A's 3,456 replies re-encoded with the Llama-3.3 tokenizer (inputs/llama33_tokenizer), mean 399.8
sampling.submission: one LLM.generate call over all 216 cells (SUBMISSION_CHUNK 256 > 216), lora_request=None, use_tqdm=False; text = completion.text.rstrip()
sampling.prompt: tokenizer.apply_chat_template([system prism4, user], tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) passed as a text prompt; vLLM 0.26.0 tokenizes it with add_special_tokens=True (renderers/base.py default_cmpl_tok_params; tokenizer(prompt, add_special_tokens=True) at renderers/base.py:481), on top of the template's own <|begin_of_text|>

tiers.name: tp4
tiers.query: num_gpus=4 gpu_name in [H200,H200_NVL] gpu_ram>=139 reliability>0.98 rentable=true inet_down>=1000 disk_space>=270 cuda_max_good>=13.0 verified=true

box.tier_rule: TP4 only: base A's tensor-parallel size and GPU count. There is no TP2 tier. A 2-card box departs from base A on TP, GPU count and KV cache (367,040 against 1,181,136 tokens), and runs only on the owner's explicit word, with a new tier here and an amended registration. Within the tier the cheapest projection wins. No card form is preferred: base A's log names no card, only 139.8 GiB per card, which fits both H200 and H200 NVL. When no offer passes, the launcher rents nothing. --poll is read-only: it re-reads the offers every poll_minutes (free) until one passes or poll_max_hours ends, then exits; the YES=1 launch that follows re-reads everything and rents. No loop creates a billable resource (OPERATIONS.md 3.4).
box.min_reliability_note: Lowered from 0.99 on 2026-11-15 04:55 UTC: from 04:01 to 04:51 no 4-card H200 offer had reliability above 0.99 with inet_down >= 1000 Mb/s (six offers read at 04:51, reliability 0.950 to 0.993). A failed host costs its minutes before the arrival checks destroy it, inside the cap. Not a stack factor.
box.job_cap_source: STANDING_INSTRUCTIONS B71, 2026-11-15 amendment (commits 9eb9d62 and 774d9bb): the box job cap is $30, so the draw runs on base A's own GPU count and tensor-parallel size, with more than $20 of margin above zero credit.
box.effective_cap_rule: cap = min(job_cap_usd - every rehearsal's recorded spend, live credit - credit_margin_usd - (sum of dph_total of every other live instance on the account) x other_burn_horizon_hours). Read at preflight and again right before the create; a later round never exceeds the first round's cap less what failed hosts cost. An offer is rented only when its projection with contingency is at or below that cap; the teardown deadline and the sampler's abort use the same cap.

runner._doc: box_runner.sh time guards, so a hopeless run stops before it bills toward the deadline.
runner.weights_budget_note: From the runner's start. 141.12 GB at the 1,000 Mb/s offer floor takes 18.8 min; the 4-card host of 2026-11-15 01:44 offered 3,017 Mb/s (6.2 min).
runner.exclude_newer_note: uv pip install --exclude-newer: every package pip must add is resolved as of base A's engine start (collect.log 2026-08-03 23:52 UTC), the latest moment base A's install can have run. Packages the image already holds are kept, as pip kept them for base A. vllm 0.26.0 (2026-07-25), transformers 5.14.1 (2026-07-16), tokenizers 0.23.1 (2026-04-27), flashinfer-python 0.6.14 (2026-07-02) and cuda-toolkit 13.0.2 (2025-12-19) were all uploaded before it (PyPI JSON, read 2026-11-15). A uv failure falls back to plain pip, recorded as a deviation.
runner.start_rule: the engine starts only when now + engine_init + sampling (phase_minutes for the TP, without contingency) is at or before the teardown deadline; else RC 22 and the watcher tears the box down

watch._doc: watch_exact_stack.py, started detached on this Mac by the launcher after READY: the cap and the idle rule in code.

rehearsal._doc: launch_exact_stack.py --rehearse: runner stages env, install and versions on the cheapest one-card CUDA 13 host with the same image, then capture and destroy. Its spend counts inside job_cap_usd.

rehearsal.query_note: Ampere or newer, so vLLM's CUDA platform resolves as on the H200s; read 2026-11-15 02:5x UTC: RTX 3060 to RTX A4000 at $0.07 to $0.10/h.

phase_minutes._source: create-to-ready 0.98 measured (box 58284750, tmp/nullext_launch.log), budgeted 2.0; vLLM 0.26.0 install has no timed record, budgeted 8.0 (vLLM 0.11.0 took 2.85, idt-r2-nullext provision_local.log), overlapped with the weight fetch at the offer's own inet_down; engine init 4.30 at TP4 (base A collect.log 23:52:06 to 23:56:24) and 5.93 at TP2 (third_party_politics tpp_collect.log 12:10:38 to 12:16:34, vLLM 0.26.0, same code); sampling at TP4 22.52 (base A, 3,456 replies, 1,381,765 completion tokens, 1,023 tokens/s) and at TP2 48.05 (base A's 1,381,765 tokens at the 479 tokens/s of the TP2 third_party_politics base arm, 441,408 tokens in 921 s); capture to destroy 1.9 measured (box 58284750), budgeted 5.0. The go/no-go projection multiplies sampling by sampling_contingency.
